metrics.label: Cash vulnerability index
metrics.description: How exposed residents would be to a loss of cash services: the average of the cash reliance and access gap scores below. Higher means more vulnerable
metrics.cash: Combines who relies on cash with how hard it is to get.

metrics.label: Cash reliance score
metrics.description: Average score on four drivers of cash use: share aged 65 and over, disadvantage (IRSD), share First Nations, and low household income. Each is scaled 0 to 100 across regions
metrics.cash: Older, lower-income and remote First Nations communities rely on cash most.

metrics.label: Cash access gap score
metrics.description: Average score on distance to the nearest cash access point, share of residents more than 10 km away, and branch closures since 2017. Each is scaled 0 to 100 across regions
metrics.cash: Distance and closures raise the cost of using cash.

metrics.label: Distance to nearest cash access point
metrics.description: Population-weighted average straight-line distance from each SA2's centre to the nearest bank branch, Bank@Post outlet, bank ATM or other face-to-face point
metrics.cash: The further away cash is, the harder it is to use.

metrics.label: Residents more than 10 km from cash
metrics.description: Share of residents whose SA2 centre is more than 10 km in a straight line from the nearest cash access point
metrics.cash: The further away cash is, the harder it is to use.

metrics.label: Population
metrics.description: Usual residents, 2021 Census

metrics.label: Population density
metrics.description: Residents per square kilometre

metrics.label: Median age
metrics.description: Median age of residents
metrics.cash: Older Australians use cash more than younger ones.

metrics.label: Aged 65 and over
metrics.description: Share of residents aged 65 and over
metrics.cash: Older Australians use cash more than younger ones.

metrics.label: Median household income
metrics.description: Median total household income, weekly
metrics.cash: Lower-income households are more likely to rely on cash.

metrics.label: Socio-economic index (IRSD)
metrics.description: Population-weighted IRSD score. Lower means more disadvantaged; Australia is about 1000
metrics.cash: Disadvantaged areas tend to rely more on cash.

metrics.label: Living in the most disadvantaged areas
metrics.description: Share of residents in areas in the bottom 20% nationally on IRSD
metrics.cash: Disadvantaged areas tend to rely more on cash.

metrics.label: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander
metrics.description: Share of residents identifying as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander
metrics.cash: Relevant to cash access in remote communities and to engagement on the $5 redesign.

metrics.label: Born overseas
metrics.description: Share of residents born outside Australia

metrics.label: Speak another language at home
metrics.description: Share of residents using a language other than English at home
metrics.cash: Relevant to public education on banknote security features.

metrics.label: Median rent
metrics.description: Median weekly rent

metrics.label: Bank-operated ATMs per 10,000 people
metrics.description: ATM machines run by banks and other ADIs (APRA), per 10,000 residents. Excludes independent ATM operators
metrics.cash: Fewer ATMs means harder access to cash.

metrics.label: Bank branches per 10,000 people
metrics.description: Branches of banks and other ADIs (APRA), per 10,000 residents
metrics.cash: Branches are a key way to deposit and withdraw cash.

metrics.label: Change in bank-operated ATMs since 2017
metrics.description: Percentage change in bank-operated ATMs since June 2017. Partly reflects banks selling ATMs to independent operators
metrics.cash: Shrinking networks raise the cost and effort of using cash.

metrics.label: Bank@Post outlets per 10,000 people
metrics.description: Australia Post outlets offering Bank@Post banking (APRA), per 10,000 residents
metrics.cash: Bank@Post is often the last face-to-face banking service in small towns.

metrics.label: Change in branches since 2017
metrics.description: Percentage change in branches since June 2017
metrics.cash: Shrinking networks raise the cost and effort of using cash.
